recipes.title: Parking Lot Bloom
recipes.style_prompt: Original English indie pop, jangly electric guitar, melodic bass, simple live drums, soft synth pad, light shaker, dry intimate verse, bright sing-along chorus, wistful optimism.
recipes.structure_excerpt:
[Verse]
I found a flower in the parking lot
Growing through the faded white line
Maybe something small can beat the dark
Maybe I can make it this time
[Chorus]
Open the window, let the morning through
Even the concrete holds a drop of blue
Open the window, I'm coming home to you
recipes.exclude_styles: Broadway belting, EDM festival drums, heavy distortion, and abstract poetry.
